text:
Maria Gonzalez: Heads-up — planning to cut SDK v8 to prod next Thursday 09:00 PT. Need to confirm deploy owner, canary plan, smoke checklist, and rollback command. Also want final sign-off on backward-compat notes for clients.
Akash Patel: I can own the deploy window. Are we doing phased canary + gradual ramp or full cut?
Maria Gonzalez: Phased canary. Start 5% for 30m, then 25% for 45m, 100% after smoke pass. Need to ensure telemetry for token-level errors is flagged.
Priya Rao: FYI, the breaking change is default behavior for multipart responses — we added a stricter validation flag. We added a compatibility shim under `SDK.v8.compat` but clients must opt-in to strict validation. Include in release notes.
Simon Lee: Can we add an automatic fallback policy if >1% 5xx in a window? We should route canary traffic back to v7.4.2 automatically.
Akash Patel: Yes — runtime supports route fallback. Proposed canary config:
```yaml
canary:
  - pct: 5
    duration: 30m
    monitor: "errors>1%"
  - pct: 25
    duration: 45m
    monitor: "latency>p95>750ms or errors>1%"
rollout_on_pass: true
rollback_command: "rdeploy rollback --service sdk-api --to v7.4.2"
```
Priya Rao: Smoke checklist (short):
- sanity: basic generate & embed on canary
- auth: key rotation test for rotated token
- perf: p95 latency < 750ms on canary nodes
- quality: run 20 PromptSet samples, compare diffs and flag >5% regression
- logs: token-level error counts visible in Console
Simon Lee: I'll own the smoke harness and run the PromptSet after 25% stage. I'll post results to this thread.
Maria Gonzalez: Who will send client comms? Need migration notes, code snippets showing `SDK.v8.compat` opt-in, and deprecation timeline for old behavior.
Priya Rao: I'll draft the client note and migration snippet. Plan: 4-week deprecation notice, with SDK v8 docs showing the explicit opt-in.
Akash Patel: Oncall for that window? @Simon Lee will be primary, @Maria Gonzalez secondary.
Simon Lee: confirmed, I'll be monitoring logs and tracing for 09:00–12:00 PT. Pager escalation: eng-oncall if we hit >2% errors sustained >15m.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: deploy/SDK-v8-cutover by Akash Patel at 2026-11-04T09:00:00-07:00. Canary policy attached.
Maria Gonzalez: Double-check client compatibility matrix in the PR and add a note for mobile SDK users — older mobile clients should pin to v7 until they opt-in.
Priya Rao: Added migration snippet to PR #4721 and updated CHANGELOG. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/4721
Akash Patel: Final: I'll start the canary at 09:00 PT. If smoke passes, I'll ramp at 09:45. Rollback command (repeatable): `rdeploy rollback --service sdk-api --to v7.4.2 --reason "v8-canary-fail"`.
Simon Lee: I'll post smoke results here. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback and ping infra. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks — team, please ack if you read this and are good with roles/timing.
Akash Patel: ack
Priya Rao: ack
Simon Lee: ack
Maria Gonzalez: Great. I'll send a short heads-up to #product before the cutover and publish client note post-deploy if all green.
